The canyon report makes public the merge explicitly at each summit. Each collapsed cluster gets one whisper weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. So the marginal impostor costs more than the marginal honest participant earns in 9 epochs. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
